name: Flash-Next UD-IQ3_XXS quantized compressed version: own Xe runtime, two B70 cards

library.variant: UD-IQ3_XXS quantized compressed version; own arithmetic-v2 oracle
library.summary: Our Xe runtime on two B70 cards. The approved capped lab result is 37.856264 tok/s, with all twelve 128-token outputs exactly matching CPU oracles. Separate from official FP8. Clean-host replay and the 512-token final performance gate remain pending.
library.benchmark_status: Approved LocalMaxxing cmv6pugme0020oa01fjrho6nx: 37.85626413203107 tok/s class-balanced over 99 intervals at capacity 4096, 12/12 exact 128-token requests. This capped observation is retained in Test details; 512-token final gate and fresh full-suite repeats pending. Standard 512-token prefill not measured.

hardware.note: 97 GiB available required by guarded model windows; adjacent pair, two rank processes (TP2).

runtime.engine: Own Xe runtime, packet44-context; arithmetic iq3-p17-detmath-v2
runtime.note: Source build; no published image or binary assets. Native controller, official MTP draft with draft-only 8-bit requantization, unchanged target verification.

project_patches.note: Own source runtime; no external runtime base or patch overlay.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Model-specific Xe runtime, deterministic arithmetic-v2 CPU oracle, native two-rank controller and target-verified draft integration.
contributors.validated_effect: 12/12 capped requests exact; 37.856264 class-balanced tok/s at 4096 capacity. This is not a matched FP8 or cross-arithmetic quality comparison.
